text:
maria_cs: Heads up — Speedline onboarding hit a perf regression overnight. p50 went from 120ms -> 210ms and p95 spiked to ~1.2s after the 3.2 model push. Renewals ping at the end of the month, we should act before enablement demo next week.
aj_dev: Thanks, Maria. Do we have a dominant invocation pattern? short chat messages or long docs?
maria_cs: Mostly short messages (avg 30 tokens) but a minority of long summarization requests that drive KV growth. The surge correlates with a nightly ingestion job.
olivia_sre: Got it. I'd propose a two-step: 1) route short tail requests to compact-int8 variant, 2) canary a prefix cache for the long ones. That should reduce latency tail and cost.
aj_dev: Agree. We can add simple routing rule in the policy layer. Example snippet: ```
- match: { tokens: { lt: 64 } }
  route: speedline-compact-int8
  weight: 0.7
- match: { tokens: { gte: 64 } }
  route: speedline-3.2
  weight: 1.0
```
li_eng: Quick note — compact-int8 reduces token cost ~45% in our benchmarks but expect slight quality delta on long coherent outputs. We should capture a small evalset of 50 long prompts.
sam_re: Renewal risk: they mentioned latency on the QBR pre-call. If we show a measurable p95 drop and cost delta, that's a win. Can we schedule a short enablement demo after the canary?
maria_cs: Yes. I'll book a 30-min slot next Tue. Also want to capture customer feedback during demo and a post-demo survey (2 questions).
olivia_sre: I'll run a canary: 10% traffic -> compact-int8 for 48h, with auto-rollback on >5% error increase or >10% QoE regression on eval set. deploy-bot: :rocket: Canary deploy initiated: speedline-compact-int8-canary -> 10%
aj_dev: I'll add routing rule to the console and create a dashboard: p50/p95, errors, embedding similarity on eval.
li_eng: For the eval, capture: (1) factual accuracy on summaries, (2) coherence score. I'll draft eval harness and a few prompts.
sam_re: Also flag the renewal owner and include the improvement chart in the renewal deck.
maria_cs: Thanks team. Quick checklist: canary up (olivia), eval ready (li), dashboard (aj), customer demo booked (maria). I'll post a short feedback form link once demo ends.
olivia_sre: Canary live. Monitoring hooks in place. Ping me in #eng-oncall if anything noisy.
maria_cs: Thanks — I'll update the account health doc and loop in AM for the renewal slide. :thumbsup:
aj_dev: Great, will follow up with the exact route config and cost estimates in this thread.
li_eng: Draft eval available here: https://redwood.internal/eval/speedline-compact-50 (internal) — please review.
sam_re: Copy. If the metrics move favorably, I'll push the renewal positive note to execs.
maria_cs: Closing loop: will capture customer notes after demo and post final recommendation. :white_check_mark:
